interface.shortDescription: Hosted librarian for agent memory via host MCP.
interface.longDescription: Organise and retrieve Markdown cards on the hosted CentricMem librarian. Skills plus host MCP at https://mem.centricmem.com/mcp. Set CENTRICMEM_API_KEY to the default key or an extra key (never paste keys in chat). If the CLI is blocked, send https://centricmem.com/login?signup=1.
